subject: Altair Cloud — follow-up and scheduling for technical deep dive
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@altaircloud.com>, Kevin Park <kevin@altaircloud.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-23T09:12:00+01:00
Subject: Altair Cloud — follow-up and scheduling for technical deep dive

Hi Elena / Kevin —

Thanks again for carving out time this morning for the marketplace discovery. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can lock a technical deep dive (partner-led):

- Recap: Altair is evaluating a marketplace listing to support managed services bundles. Main priorities: predictable latency targets for inference, integration points for billing reconciliation, and network/security constraints for private deployments.
- Next step: 90-minute technical deep dive with Redwood engineering + Altair SA to confirm integration touchpoints (IAM, marketplace listing fields, network allowlist, and test harness).

Proposed slots (CET):
- Fri 24 Sep, 10:00–11:30
- Mon 27 Sep, 14:00–15:30

Please tell us which works (or share a calendar link) and who on your side will own the SA portion. I’m looping Camila (partner onboarding) for marketplace navigation and Ben (technical lead) for the deep-dive agenda.

Attachments: I have a short intake template (MAA) I can share to accelerate prep — will attach once we confirm a slot.

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Partnerships (EMEA)
Redwood Inference
vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai

From: Elena Rossi <elena@altaircloud.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-23T13:45:00+01:00
Subject: Re: Altair Cloud — follow-up and scheduling for technical deep dive

Hi Vivek —

Thanks for the clear summary. Both proposed times are possible for us; Kevin and I prefer Fri 24 Sep 10:00–11:30 CET. Our SA (Kevin) will lead the internal side — he can cover IAM and billing questions. For agenda, we’d like to include: 1) anticipated API surface for listing & consumption, 2) billing reconciliation flow, 3) network/egress constraints for our managed tenant offering.

Two quick asks on our side before the deep dive:
- Can you send the intake template (MAA) and any environment prerequisites?
- We’ll need a short list of Redwood participants by role (e.g., runtime engineer vs partner/onboarding).

I can send a provisional calendar invite once you confirm the final attendee list.

Best,
Elena Rossi
Partnerships Lead — Cloud Integrations
Altair Cloud
elena@altaircloud.com

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@altaircloud.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-23T14:10:00+01:00
Subject: Re: Altair Cloud — follow-up and scheduling for technical deep dive

Perfect — Fri 24 Sep 10:00–11:30 CET is penciled in on our side.

Attendees from Redwood (confirmed):
- Vivek Kulkarni — Partner lead (overview, showstoppers)
- Ben Carter — Runtime / integration technical lead (will drive the deep dive)
- Camila Reyes — Marketplace onboarding and paperwork

Ben — I’m handing the technical agenda to you. Can you confirm you’re OK with 24 Sep and drop a short agenda + any prep asks? Once Ben replies I’ll send the calendar invite and attach the MAA intake template.

Thanks — Vivek

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Rossi <elena@altaircloud.com>, Kevin Park <kevin@altaircloud.com>
Date: 2026-09-23T17:05:00+01:00
Subject: Re: Altair Cloud — follow-up and scheduling for technical deep dive

Thanks Vivek — 24 Sep 10:00–11:30 CET works for me. Proposed 90-min agenda from Redwood engineering:

1) 10:00–10:10 — Intros & scope confirmation (Vivek / Elena)
2) 10:10–10:35 — Integration surface & auth model (Ben) — what endpoints we expose for marketplace listing, token exchange, and webhook flows
3) 10:35–11:00 — Networking & security (Ben + Kevin) — allowlist requirements, TLS/cert expectations, private deployment constraints
4) 11:00–11:20 — Billing & reconciliation approach (Camila + Elena)
5) 11:20–11:30 — Open Qs & next steps (all)

Prep asks:
- Elena: please share your network allowlist and any testing IP ranges ahead of time (we can add to the invite).
- Kevin: have your SA bring one sample listing spec or example fields you expect in the marketplace payload.

I attached a short technical intake (redwood-technical-intake-MAA.pdf) that captures runtime footprints, expected qps, and required endpoints — fill the highlighted fields and drop back into this thread when convenient.

Ben Carter
Principal Backend Engineer — Inference Runtime
Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai
Attachment: redwood-technical-intake-MAA.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Elena Rossi <elena@altaircloud.com>

Subject: Re: Altair Cloud — follow-up and scheduling for technical deep dive

Thanks everyone — invite sent for Fri 24 Sep 10:00–11:30 CET (Google Calendar link below). I attached our network allowlist and a short one-pager that outlines the managed-tenant constraints we referenced. Kevin will lead the SA section and send a sample listing spec before the meeting. Looking forward to the deep dive.
